en: Brandon, congratulations.
Here's the thing, I thought you played
with huge courage at the end.
You were really going after the forehand.
What gave you the ability
to do that and seize the moment?
Yeah, I think just getting a lot of confidence
from all these matches.
When it comes down to the wire
in the third set, just trying
to trust my game fully and just really proud
of how I ended the match.
What learnings were there
from the match you played
in Washington recently?
Yeah,
I mean the match in Washington I felt like
from the baseline I wasn't playing that well,
I wasn't hitting through my shots as much.
So today I was really trying
to hit the forehand a little bit bigger
and you know staying solid
on the backhand and I think
that was what got me through.
If I was to have told you after Wimbledon
you'd play Washington semi-finals,
Montreal final and now Cincy semi-final,
what would you have told me?
I wouldn't have believed you.
Yeah, it's been a lot these last few weeks,
a lot of emotions,
you know a lot of hours out here
on the court but in the end I'm super happy
with my level and yeah just really proud
of myself.
So what opportunity have you got
this weekend?
Another opportunity
to win some more matches,
I mean I'll try my best, get some recovery
and we'll see how it goes.
Great job, well done.
Alright, thank you.
